messages:
incident-bot: pagerduty: page fired -> service=inference-queue, symptom=queue-backlog, severity=high, alert_id=PD-84732

pagerduty: PD alert PD-84732 triggered for 'inference-queue: backlog > 2k'

alice: Ack'ing — I'm on it. seeing 2.3k queue length across prod region-us-west1.

bob: I'm looking at autoscaler metrics now. avg provision latency ~ 5m, node requests spiking.

carol: Alerts show burst from a customer batch job hitting hot prefixes. prefix cache warmup is lagging.

alice: Confirmed customer spike. Is autoscaler respecting the burst policy? I see desired replicas climbing slowly (200 -> 260 over 12m).

dave: Looks like cloud provider throttled new instance launches — rate limit 10/min hit. tickets open but we need live mitigation.

erin: If we can't spin up nodes fast enough, we should: 1) enable burst-capacity fallback (smaller instances), 2) scale down model concurrency to reduce per-request GPU footprint, or 3) temporarily redirect low-priority traffic to degraded tier. Which is fastest?

bob: Quick wins: manual scale a preemptible pool we can add immediately, and bump autoscaler surge config. I'll run the commands.

bob: Running: ```kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=320 -n prod --context=prod-west1```

alice: Also enabling routing rule to divert non-critical embeddings jobs to cached responses: toggling route /embeddings -> cached-edge for 30m.

incident-bot: action logged: manual scale requested by bob at 6281234569.

pagerduty: PD-84732 acknowledged by alice at 6281234570. escalation paused.

carol: After manual scale, queue length dropped to ~1.6k but still trending down slowly. provision backlog cleared for 70% of requests.

dave: Provider rate-limit ticket updated (CL-9981). ETA unknown. Ops asked to throttle job submitters on partner side — pinging partner SRE.

erin: I pushed a temporary model fallback config to reduce p99 latency and GPU time: `model.hot -> model.small-v2` for routes with less strict quality. This should reduce token compute.

alice: Noting customer impact: several low-priority background jobs delayed; a handful of real-time inference calls saw 4-8s added tail latency. No finished customer-facing outage detected yet. Logging communication to #support for visibility.

bob: Running a quick KVCACHE preload for top prefixes to help warmups: ```./tools/preload_prefixes --top 200 --region us-west1```

incident-bot: update: queue length 980 at 6281234578. autoscaler desired replicas 310.

alice: Good. I'm handing this to the morning oncall (carol) for watch and runbook follow-up — handoff now. Carol, you own coordination with partner SRE and follow-up remediation.

carol: Taking ownership. I'll keep the route diversion and model fallback for 1h and reassess. Will open a follow-up incident if backlog climbs again.

dave: Filing followup ticket to review autoscaler surge config and provider quota: OP-5177. Recommend increasing instance launch rate and adding warm pool.

alice: Thanks team — closing PD-84732 as mitigated but keep monitoring. Please add timeline + notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:

pagerduty: PD-84732 resolved by alice at 6281234589.

incident-bot: runbook ref: docs/runbooks/autoscaler-backlog.md | postmortem owner: carol | severity: high -> mitigated
